title: From Spontaneous Ignitions to Sensorimotor Cell Assemblies via Dopamine: A Spiking Neurocomputational Model of Infants' Hand Action Acquisition.
summary: Spiking neural network uses Hebbian plasticity and simulated dopamine reward; Methods explicitly defines network, assumptions, and data acquisition. Results reports simulated assembly size and ignition frequency changes across reward conditions, with paired tests; computational model result only, not direct infant observation.
